node.title: COUNTEREXAMPLE (verified): quotient-pullback families give exponential sub-Johnson auxiliary lists
node.statement: Explicit construction (Codex; verified here by hand + numerically at F_31): petals = quotient fibers T_i = {x^ell = alpha_i}, L_D = H(X^ell) a pullback locator, W_S = G_S(X^ell) with G_S(Y) = Y H(Y) - prod_{i in S}(Y - alpha_i) (leading terms cancel): each W_S agrees with U* on exactly (m+1) ell = d + ell points; C(M, m+1) distinct members; sub-Johnson whenever (m+1)^2 < Mm. The unqualified correlated-target hope is FALSE: shared L_D alone cannot give poly wide lists. The family is PURE PULLBACK — chargeable to the quotient-profile budget; at the L1 cutoff M = O(log n), so the mass is poly-but-budgeted (it consumes exponent, realizing the conj:B profile term concretely).
